description: Enters your Ajour week in the Workday timesheet through a coding agent and a Chrome window. Unofficial: it drives Workday's web page and breaks when the page changes. It never signs in for you.

settings.label: Workday timesheet URL
settings.helpText: Open Enter Time in Workday and copy the address.

settings.label: Sign-in username
settings.helpText: Optional. The agent types it when Workday's sign-in page asks for an email or username, so sign-in can finish without you while Chrome still has your company session. It never types a password or a code.
